start.title: Прежде Всего
start.text:
Ещё ничего не существует.
Только ты — и глубокая, бесконечная тьма.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You wait. The darkness presses closer — patient, heavy.
[TODO:ru] Your hand stretches forward. Something stirs beneath the surface.
[TODO:ru] A sound rises from deep within you — the first sound ever made.

silence.title: Великое Безмолвие
silence.text:
Ты ждёшь в тишине.
Пустота ноет — ей нужно что-то ещё.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The word gathers inside you — heavy with purpose.
[TODO:ru] Your breath ripples across the deep. Something awakens.

voice.title: Слово
voice.text:
Твой голос прорывается сквозь ничто.
Он несёт в себе тяжесть вечности.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The command explodes from you. There is no turning back.
[TODO:ru] The whisper leaves your lips — soft, yet unstoppable.

void.title: Бесформенная Бездна
void.text:
Бесконечные воды простираются под тобой.
Ты паришь над бездной.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You lower yourself. The water trembles at your presence.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stir the surface with your breath
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your breath moves across the face of the deep.

light.title: Да Будет Свет
light.text:
Свет исходит от тебя — ослепительный, бесконечный.
Впервые пустоту наполняет тепло.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The light races outward — filling every void.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Shape the light — give it edges
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You cup the light in your hands. It pulses, alive.
[TODO:ru] You draw a line between light and dark. Order begins.

light_obey.title: Да Будет Свет
light_obey.text:
Твоя команда сотрясает пустоту.
Свет взрывается — бесконечный, ослепительный, живой.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Warmth gathers around you — golden, tender.
[TODO:ru] The light obeys. It floods the emptiness without end.

light_awe.title: Да Будет Свет
light_awe.text:
Свет мягко поднимается из твоего дыхания.
Сначала нежный — затем пылающий, неудержимый.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You press the light upward — it stretches into sky.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Divide the light from the dark
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Shadow and radiance separate at your touch.

warmth.title: Первое Тепло
warmth.text:
Свет превращается в тепло.
Ты чувствуешь, как творение отзывается на твое прикосновение.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You reach upward. The sky begins to unfold.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Spread your hands — expand it all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Everything stretches — wider, higher, limitless.

day_night.title: Вечер и Утро
day_night.text:
Ты называешь свет Днем, а тьму Ночью.
Первый закат. Первый рассвет.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You move forward. There is more to create.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Pause — linger in what you've made
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You stop. The colors are yours — and they are beautiful.

sky.title: Небеса Вверху
sky.text:
Ты простираешь небо, как занавес.
Воды разделяются — вверху и внизу.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Command the dry land to appear
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your voice strikes the deep. The earth begins to rise.
[TODO:ru] The waters obey — drawing inward, making room.
[TODO:ru] You pause. The sky stretches further than you imagined.

sky_vast.title: Обширное Небо
sky_vast.text:
Синева простирается бесконечно во всех направлениях.
Твое творение превосходит даже то, что ты себе представлял.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You speak downward. The ground trembles in answer.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Gather the seas into their places
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The waters rush to their boundaries — eager, wild.

waters_gather.title: Собрание Вод
waters_gather.text:
Ты направляешь океаны на их места.
Реки прокладывают пути по твоему велению.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Raise the mountains from the deep
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Stone groans upward. The peaks reach toward you.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Shape the earth with your hands
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You kneel. The soil is warm beneath your fingers.

expanse.title: Купол Небес
expanse.text:
Небо выгибается, как собор, который ты построил.
Каждое направление таит в себе обещание.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You look down. The earth rises to meet your gaze.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Press your hands into the earth
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your palms sink into the clay. It yields to you.

land.title: Суша
land.text:
Горы поднимаются по твоему слову.
Зелень прорывается — внезапно, дико, повсюду.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Plant a forest with a thought
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Trees spring up — tall, ancient, reaching for your sky.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Craft the first flower by hand
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] A single bloom opens in your palm. Perfect.
[TODO:ru] You ascend. The world unfolds beneath you.

land_emerge.title: Земля Поднимается
land_emerge.text:
Твердая земля образуется под твоим прикосновением.
Ты чувствуешь, как земля дышит впервые.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Seeds fall from your hands like rain. Life begins.
[TODO:ru] You watch it grow — slowly, tenderly, from nothing.

plants.title: Первый Сад
plants.text:
Деревья тянутся к небу, которое ты создал.
Плоды висят тяжелые — сладкие, нетронутые.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Sweetness fills you — your own gift, tasted for the first time.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Wait for darkness — then fill it
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You wait. The empty sky calls to you.

flowers.title: Неназванные Цвета
flowers.text:
Лепестки раскрываются от твоего прикосновения.
Цвета, которых ни один глаз никогда не видел — до сих пор.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The scent is unlike anything. Because nothing existed before.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Turn your gaze upward — the sky is empty
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The dark sky waits — a canvas, unfinished.

mountain.title: Вершина
mountain.text:
С вершины ты видишь все, что создал.
Пустое небо — ждущее наполнения.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You reach up. The first star burns in your hand.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Descend — there is more to do
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You climb down. The work is not yet finished.

stars.title: Солнце, Луна и Звезды
stars.text:
Ты вешаешь солнце, как светильник.
Тысячи звезд летят с твоих кончиков пальцев.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The ocean stretches before you — vast, silent, waiting.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Place every star one by one
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Each star finds its place. You name them all.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Set the moon in its place
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Silver rises. The night breathes softly.

stars_delight.title: Солнце, Луна и Звезды
stars_delight.text:
Сладость остается — твое творение хорошо.
Над тобой небо ждет света.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Fire leaps from your fingers. The sky blazes.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Paint the night sky with silver
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Moonlight pours down — gentle, steady, yours.

stars_vision.title: Солнце, Луна и Звезды
stars_vision.text:
С вершины горы ты бросаешь звезды во тьму.
Каждая из них — обещание.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] More. More. The darkness shrinks with every throw.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Set the moon to guard the night
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The moon rises — faithful, watching over what you made.

countless_stars.title: Бесчисленные
countless_stars.text:
Ты помещаешь их за пределами счета.
Каждая из них — завет — шепот того, что грядет.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Below, the waters are still. They need life.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Rest a moment beneath your sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You lie back. Your stars shine above you.

moonrise.title: Меньший Светильник
moonrise.text:
Серебряный свет льется на неподвижные воды.
Луна занимает свое место — верная, тихая.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You turn to the deep. It's time to fill it.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Wait for the dawn you designed
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You wait. The horizon glows with approaching light.

sea_dawn.title: Рассвет Над Бездной
sea_dawn.text:
Наступает рассвет — твой рассвет.
Воды волнуются, готовые принять жизнь.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your voice enters the water. Movement begins.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Listen to the silence before it fills
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] One last breath of stillness. Then — everything.

sea_creatures.title: [TODO:ru] The Waters Teem
sea_creatures.text:
[TODO:ru] You fill the seas — whales, fish, swarms of life.
Birds burst from your hands — filling the sky with song.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Turn to the land — it's still empty
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The ground waits. You have more to give.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send a bird soaring across the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Wings spread. The bird trusts the wind you made.

bird_flight.title: [TODO:ru] First Flight
bird_flight.text:
[TODO:ru] Wings catch the wind you made.
The bird knows no fear — only sky.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Return to the ground — fill it next
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You descend. The earth needs creatures of its own.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Feel the wind on your face
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The breeze you made touches your skin. It's good.

land_creatures.title: [TODO:ru] Every Living Thing
land_creatures.text:
[TODO:ru] You speak — lions, deer, serpents, insects appear.
The earth breathes with life you gave it.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Something is still missing — press on
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] A restlessness stirs in you. This isn't finished.
[TODO:ru] They gather around you — warm, trusting, alive.

land_creatures_wind.title: [TODO:ru] Every Living Thing
land_creatures_wind.text:
[TODO:ru] You stand among creatures — wild, warm, alive.
They do not run. They know your voice.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You sit. They press close — unafraid.
[TODO:ru] The ache rises. None of them can truly know you.

among_animals.title: [TODO:ru] Among the Creatures
among_animals.text:
[TODO:ru] They gather around you — trusting, alive.
But none of them can know you. Not truly.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Feel the ache of being alone
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The loneliness deepens. You need someone who understands.
[TODO:ru] You stand. Your hands know what to do.

before_man.title: [TODO:ru] The Sixth Day
before_man.text:
[TODO:ru] You kneel in the dust.
Your hands begin to shape something new — something like you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your fingers press into the dust. A form takes shape.
[TODO:ru] The words leave your lips. The clay trembles.

before_man_lonely.title: [TODO:ru] The Sixth Day
before_man_lonely.text:
[TODO:ru] The ache deepens — you want to be known.
You kneel in the dust and begin.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Shape the clay with trembling hands
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your hands shake. This one will be different.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Take your time — this matters most
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You slow down. Every detail matters.

breath_of_life.title: [TODO:ru] The Breath of Life
breath_of_life.text:
[TODO:ru] Dust becomes flesh under your hands.
You lean close — and breathe life into him.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] His eyes open. He sees you first.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Place him gently in the garden
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You carry him — warm, breathing — into paradise.

breath_of_life_sacred.title: [TODO:ru] The Breath of Life
breath_of_life_sacred.text:
[TODO:ru] Your breath enters the clay.
His chest rises. His heart beats — once, twice, forever.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You lay him gently on the grass. He stirs.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stand back — let him see the world
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You step away. His eyes open to everything you made.

first_garden.title: [TODO:ru] Eden
first_garden.text:
[TODO:ru] Paradise stretches before you — your masterpiece.
You look at all you have made.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Say it — the words that complete it all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The words rise in you — final, certain.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Sit beside your creation in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You sit. No words needed. It is enough.

first_garden_wonder.title: [TODO:ru] Eden
first_garden_wonder.text:
[TODO:ru] He stands in the garden — alive, breathing, yours.
Everything — all of it — was for this moment.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your voice fills the garden — warm, full, complete.
[TODO:ru] You exhale. It is done.

very_good.title: [TODO:ru] Very Good
very_good.text:
[TODO:ru] "It is very good."
You smile upon your work.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Peace settles over everything.

rest.title: [TODO:ru] The Seventh Day
rest.text:
[TODO:ru] You rest. All creation breathes.
The story has only just begun.

rest_blessed.title: [TODO:ru] The Seventh Day
rest_blessed.text:
[TODO:ru] You rest beside the one you made.
Peace fills every corner of your world.
